confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from a few aggregated web guides with mixed dates, some Tokyo-based or older, converted at an assumed rough JPY/USD rate I did not verify. Cocktail and wine anchors are set above the draft beer anchor using local price relationships, with weak direct evidence. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or booking or listing pages were checked. The RBA value was taken from the RBA exchange-rates page as surfaced in search, not from a full page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Japanese prefectural capital priced below Tokyo and Osaka. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors follow typical izakaya, chain-cafe and regional restaurant ranges. Cocktail and wine are priced as a local premium over the draft beer anchor. Accommodation is a holistic estimate comparable to other mid-sized Japanese regional cities with onsen tourism.
